races.paceDynamic: Marlpark is the sole confirmed front-runner in this 17-runner field and will dictate terms from the outset without early pressure. With most runners adopting prominent or hold-up tactics, Marlpark can establish a sustainable rhythm through the early phases. The large field will likely string out behind the leader, creating a searching gallop over this stamina-testing trip on Good ground. This race shape strongly favors prominent runners who can track Marlpark closely and hold-up horses with finishing kicks, as the uncontested leader may prove vulnerable to late challenges.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Marlpark gets soft splits and the pace becomes too steady for closers to make up ground
scenarios.body: Marlpark's course form and lack of early pressure allows him to dictate ideal fractions and kick clear approaching the last. Late challengers find the sustained gallop has taken too much out of them to mount effective bids.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely searching and Marlpark begins to tire from the second-last hurdle
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop over this demanding trip exposes Marlpark's stamina limitations, allowing a well-positioned prominent runner to strike late. Course specialists and those with proven staying power capitalize on the searching conditions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Storms Home
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is moderate early but quickens dramatically from the back straight, creating a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The tactical race sets up perfectly for horses with finishing kicks who've been conserving energy in rear divisions. A strong late surge from the pack overwhelms the early leaders who lack the turn of foot for a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Marlpark goes too slow early and multiple runners make premature moves, creating a stop-start affair
scenarios.body: The tactical nature creates a muddling pace that suits nothing ideally, with multiple horses making moves at different stages. The race becomes a lottery where any horse getting the right run at the right time can capitalize on the messy development.

watchPoints.text: Marlpark's jumping under pressure - any significant mistake will immediately invite challenges from tracking horses
Small Bucks and Benzine for stamina concerns - both show patterns of fading in finish which could be exposed over this trip
Gino Bella's pulling tendency early - if he fights for his head tracking Marlpark it will compromise his finishing effort
Hatfield Hammer's position turning in - needs to be within striking distance despite 197-day absence to utilize finishing kick
Tingarran Express jumping rhythm - any fluency issues will prevent him from maintaining prominent position behind Marlpark

races.paceDynamic: Must Meet Cecil and You Done Well will lead the early gallop alongside Magnificent Era and The Cheeky Pup in a prominent group, but with 17 runners this will develop into a searching test rather than a sprint. The large field creates natural early pace pressure that will stretch the field significantly over this 2m½f trip on good ground. Multiple hold-up horses including Go To Town, Getaway Henry, and Falcon Park will rely on the strong pace to set up their finishing kicks. This race shape strongly favours hold-up performers who can pick off tiring pace-setters in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders go too hard in the large field and fade dramatically from 3f out
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop from multiple pace-setters creates the perfect setup for hold-up horses to sweep past exhausted front-runners. Patient riders on proven stayers will have clear advantages as the race develops into a war of attrition.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes more measured with jockeys holding back given the big field
scenarios.body: Prominent racers who can quicken off a steady gallop will have the tactical edge over pure hold-up horses who need stronger pace. The race becomes more about class and acceleration than stamina.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Develops
scenarios.trigger: If the good ground and 2m½f trip creates an honest gallop that doesn't stop
scenarios.body: Horses with proven stamina over this trip or longer will grind out the finish as others hit the wall. Form over similar distances becomes crucial as the race turns into a true staying test.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Fragmentation
scenarios.trigger: If the large field splits into different groups and tactical positioning becomes chaotic
scenarios.body: Horses that can adapt to unusual race shapes and have experienced jockeys will benefit from the confusion. Early positioning becomes less important than having room to maneuver in the straight.

races.paceDynamic: Welcome Back is the only confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the start without pressure. This sets up a tactical affair where the pace will be steady early before quickening from the final hurdle. The uncontested lead and gradual acceleration clearly favours hold-up horses who can produce late runs.

races.paceDynamic: King Of Kingsfield and Thecompanysergeant will likely dispute the early lead with their prominent styles, while Encanto Bruno may also press forward. This trio should establish a solid but manageable gallop over the first half of this 2m3½f test. The pace will intensify from three out as hold-up horses Farren Glory and Mighty Tom begin their challenges, creating a searching finish. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can secure good positions early and kick clear before the closers get organized.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Takes Control
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders maintain their advantage turning for home
scenarios.body: King Of Kingsfield or Thecompanysergeant will have first run on the field and can exploit their tactical edge. The hold-up horses will struggle to bridge the gap as the prominent pair have racing room and momentum.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses and bunching occurs at the second last
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where positioning matters most and any horse getting a clear run can prevail. Encanto Bruno's mid-division spot could prove ideal in this scenario.

scenarios.title: Shock Outsider

races.paceDynamic: Ned In The Park looks the only confirmed front-runner in this 17-runner handicap hurdle, with prominent racers like Coded Welder, Churchwarden, Hidalgo Des Mottes, The Monkey Pole, Portarlington and Stonecarthy likely to sit handy. With such a large field and limited early pace pressure, Ned In The Park can dictate a steady tempo through the early stages before the race develops into a sprint from the final hurdle. The majority of runners are hold-up horses including Inthenickoftime, Le Diablo, Boujee, In For The Night, Penny Jar, Takarengo, Global Skies, Mister Vic, Stumblin In and Speakasyoufind, creating a bunched field turning for home. This tactical setup strongly favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed who can position themselves within striking distance of a lone leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Lone Leader Dictates
scenarios.trigger: If Ned In The Park gets an uncontested lead and sustains his effort
scenarios.body: The 7-year-old can control the tempo and prove hard to peg back, while prominent racers like Coded Welder and Global Skies can track the pace and finish strongly. Hold-up horses face a traffic-heavy sprint finish where positioning becomes crucial.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Creates Pace
scenarios.trigger: If several prominent runners challenge Ned In The Park early or track him closely
scenarios.body: A stronger tempo emerges that can set up the race for late closers with stamina like Inthenickoftime and Le Diablo. The increased pace will favour those held up who can unleash one run from off the speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Scramble From Hurdle
scenarios.trigger: If the large field remains tightly bunched turning for home with little pace on
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from the final flight where tactical speed and a clear passage matter most. Horses like Global Skies and Hidalgo Des Mottes who can quicken and find gaps will have the edge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Ned In The Park doesn't show his usual front-running style or gets headed early
scenarios.body: A muddling pace develops that could suit patient hold-up horses who stay strongly like Mister Vic or Stumblin In. The lack of early tempo makes it a test of stamina rather than speed.

races.paceDynamic: Fire Coral will take them along as the only confirmed front runner, with It's Time Again, Oogum Boogum, Last Note and Thewaybackhome likely to track in behind. The pace should be sustainable rather than searching, allowing the large field of hold-up horses to get into contention. With 13 of the 19 runners showing hold-up tendencies and Fire Coral having been off for 252 days, the tempo may lack intensity in the middle stages. This race shape clearly favours patient, hold-up horses who can finish strongly, as they'll have every chance to close into a modest gallop over this staying trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Fire Coral sets only a steady pace and the prominent runners fail to apply pressure
scenarios.body: The large contingent of hold-up horses get perfect tactical conditions with a modest gallop to aim at. Late closers with stamina for the trip can time their challenges perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If It's Time Again or Oogum Boogum improve the pace from halfway and kick clear
scenarios.body: The horses tracking Fire Coral get first run on the field and establish winning positions before the hold-up brigade can respond. Those with tactical speed benefit from getting into the race earlier.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Fire Coral Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Fire Coral's class tells despite the long absence and she kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The front runner capitalises on her tactical advantage and the field's failure to pressure her early. Her previous course wins and staying ability prove decisive despite the layoff.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If no horse wants to go forward and the pace becomes crawling
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish with stamina irrelevant and early positioning crucial. Horses with tactical pace rather than staying power benefit from the lack of gallop.

watchPoints.text: Fire Coral could steal this if none of the trackers pressure her early, despite being off for 252 days
Zolpharine's recent winning form makes him the most dangerous hold-up horse if getting the right pace scenario
It's Time Again's fitness after being pulled-up 10 days ago will determine if he can capitalise on prominent position
Several horses carry fading tendencies (Rizedda, Three County Star, Appian Way, Whoswhointhezoo, Sallap) making finishing kick crucial
First-time headgear on Lily Milan (cheekpieces) and Whoswhointhezoo (blinkers) could spark improvement
